defense_news.title: How North Korean forces are bolstering Russia’s war against Ukraine
defense_news.summary: North Korea has deployed troops, weapons and now, according to a Ukrainian intelligence official, a missile unit to support Russia’s war against Ukraine.

defense_news.title: Rheinmetall says ramping up ATACMS output will take time as US rebuilds stocks
defense_news.summary: Rheinmetall signed a memorandum of understanding with Lockheed last month to jointly produce Army Tactical Missile Systems.

defense_news.title: Boeing wins first production contract for jet-powered JDAM
defense_news.summary: Boeing won the first production contract for a jet-powered guided bomb that can fly more than 300 nautical miles.

defense_news.title: Iran issues warning to Gulf states: US must desist or you’ll be hit hard
defense_news.summary: Iran has made a concerted push with Gulf states, warning them explicitly that Tehran will hit their oil, power and water plants unless U.S. strikes end.

geo_news.title: YKS tercih süreci yarın sona eriyor
geo_news.summary: Üniversite adayları için 2026 Yükseköğretim Kurumları Sınavı (2026-YKS) tercih süreci yarın sona erecek.
